title: Sprocket's Wobbly Wheel

voice.name: Sprocket
voice.model: Veo native dialogue (veo-3.1-generate-001), isolated and re-voiced with eleven_multilingual_sts_v2

lines.note: sts onset 0.48; at=take[0] plays the span at its native position = on the picture mouth.
sts onset 2.54; played at native position.
sts onset 6.74, after the 3s silent fix beat; played at native position.

signoff.note: LOCKED STANDARD: bank audio/signoffs/signoff_sprocket.mp3 (clean studio read), trimmed to speech and atempo 0.80 (~1.46s) to fit the Veo tail's mouth. NOT a voice-changed tail. Tail starts at 8.0s, mouth onset ~0.60 -> at=8.6. Veo drawled the tail (1.78s mouth) vs the snappy 1.18s bank read, so only a moderate stretch was used (a full match would drag the voice).

video.description: SPROCKET the piglet (refs/characters/sprocket_ref.png): round friendly pig, brown tool belt with a gold buckle and two brown pouches, a silver wrench in one hoof, no goggles. ONE wooden wheelbarrow with a SINGLE front wheel, in the workshop (refs/locations/workshop.png). The wheel has one visible bolt on its hub.

beats.action: ACCEPTED v1: pushes the wheelbarrow, the front wheel wobbles, worried: 'Uh-oh, a wobbly wheel!'
ACCEPTED v1: leans to the wheel/bolt: 'The bolt is loose.'
ACCEPTED v1: silent ~2.6s fix beat — he works the wrench on the bolt; the wheel firms up.
ACCEPTED v1: sets the wrench down, the wheelbarrow stands upright, he beams: 'All fixed!' (speech ~6.59-7.78). Eyes open through the end.

notes: Pacing standard: ~9 words + sign-off, gaps >= 0.7s, the silent tightening is the lesson beat and never shortens. Franchise: Sprocket Fixes It. Teaches: a loose part causes a wobble; tightening the bolt fixes it. Distinct from Short 4 (intro), 6 (mystery tool), 10 (doesn't belong), 14 (before-you-fix-it rule): this is a concrete fix (tighten a loose bolt). LOCKED voice standard: re-voice main once via sts; sign-off = bank signoff_sprocket.mp3 fitted to the tail (never voice-change the tail).
